name: evtx_query
description: Parse an EVTX file and return filtered events with timestamp, event_id, channel, computer, record_id, and named data fields.

event_ids.description: Optional list of numeric event IDs to include

contains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring that must appear in the XML

limit.description: Maximum events in the JSON summary; every matching event and its full XML is kept in result_file

out_file.description: Optional JSONL result path under the run; defaults to a deterministic path under work/
